title: Trade standoff: Trump's 50% tariff kicks in; Carney vows 'dollar-for-dollar' response
content: Trade negotiations between the United States and Canada fell apart after a three-day face-off. Canada called a halt to discussions, criticizing the US for presenting proposals that were both unfair and detrimental. In a dramatic move, the US introduced hefty tariffs on Canadian goods, prompting Canada to respond with an equal retaliatory measure. This failure to reach an agreement casts uncertainty over North American trade relations moving forward.

title: 31-year-old Adobe techie beaten to death by wife’s family in Delhi

title: Elon Musk took authority away from Tesla managers and handed it to employees

Musk advised leaving meetings where value is not being added by attendees. Communication should travel directly, bypassing strict chains of command. He emphasized using common sense to guide actions and improve company execution.

title: Cornell cools campus with 39°F water from 250 ft below Cayuga Lake, cuts energy 85%

This groundbreaking initiative, which commenced construction in 1999, achieved an extraordinary eighty-five percent cut in annual energy consumption, positioning the university at the forefront of eco-friendly solutions for the future.

title: Meet Caden Pohlkamp, 7th grader who built an underwater robot to test ponds

This clever invention measures environmental variables at varying depths across twelve ponds. Results demonstrated that artificial fountains greatly enhance water quality and support aquatic life. This remarkable endeavor secured him a spot as a finalist for national junior innovator honors, with Caden Pohlkamp now seeking to expand his environmental robotics initiatives.

However, a beloved children's book published in 1942 turned the lighthouse into a cultural treasure. Thanks to public protests in 1951, the structure was preserved, becoming a beloved emblem of childhood memories.

content: police allege fugitive gangster was mastermind behind the violence in sambhal in 2024 . a red corner notice is an international request to law-enforcement agencies worldwide . police say he fled to the u.s. using a forged passport . the notice is a request to locate a person wanted for prosecution or to serve a sentence .

title: At least 2 killed, several injured in reactor blast at Telangana pharma unit
content:
Reactor blast at Telangana pharma unit

Two workers were killed and nine others injured after a reactor blast triggered a fire at a pharmaceutical unit in Telangana's Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district late Friday night, police said. The incident took place at a pharma company in Pochampally mandal while workers were changing shifts, according to police. "Two persons died. Nine people were injured, including two who suffered more than 50 per cent burns while seven sustained minor injuries", a police official told PTI. The injured workers were admitted to different hospitals for treatment, the official said. The blast triggered a fire at the unit, which was later brought under control by the Fire Department. Police have registered a case and launched an investigation into the incident.

End of Article
